quote_id.description: The quote the fax was sent under.

state.description: queued, active, delivered, partial, failed or unknown at the end of the run.

failure_code.description: The reason of a failed or partial send.

pages_sent.description: Pages the carrier reported as sent.

amount_micro.description: The quoted price in USD micro-units (39000 is $0.039).

provider_ref.description: The carrier's reference once there is one.

evidence.description: What the carrier reported on a delivered or partial fax. Data from the carrier, not legal proof.

idempotency_key.description: The key the send was queued under. The same key returns the same fax.
